spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (स्थुडति)
To clothe or cover.

m. (-री)
A packhorse, a horse carrying loads: see स्थौरिन्.

m. (-री)
A packhorse or one carrying loads on his back.
E.
स्थूल bulk, size, इनि affix, and ल changed to र.

f. (-णा)
1 The post of pillar of a house.
2 An iron image.
3 An anvil.
4 A disease.
E.
ष्ठा to stay or stand, न Uṇādi aff., deriv. irr.

m. (-रः)
A man.
E.
ष्ठा to stay, ऊरन् Uṇādi aff.

r. 10th cl. (स्थूलयते)
To increase, to fatten, to become big or bulky.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Fat, corpulent, bulky.
2 Stupid, dull, ignorant.
3 Large, great.
4

Coarse.
5

Clumsy.
n. (-लं)
1 A heap, a quantity.
2 A tent.
f. (-ला)
1 A sort of pepper, (Pothos officinalis)
2 A pumpkin gourd.
m. (-लः)
The jack fruit tree.
E.
स्थूल to be large or fat, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Large, bulky.
E.
स्थूल the same, कन added.

m. (-ङ्गुः)
A wild sort of kidney-bean.
E.
स्थूल large, and कङ्गु coix.

f. (-का)
The silk-cotton tree.
E.
स्थूल large, कण्ट a thorn, कन् aff.

m. (-न्दः)
1 An esculent root, (Arum colocasia.)
2 Another sort, (Arum Indicum.)
E.
स्थूल large, and कन्द a root.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Large bodied, corpulent.
E.
स्थूल, and काय body.

m. (-धक्)
The trunk of a tree or any piece of timber on fire.
E.
स्थूल large, काष्ठ wood, and दह burning.

m. (-ग्निः)
A large piece of wood on fire.
E.
स्थूल large, काष्ठ wood, and अग्नि fire.

m. (-डः)
An arrow.
E.
स्थूल large, and क्ष्वेड a bambu rod.

m. (-पः)
A bow used in cleaning cotton.
E.
स्थूल large, and चाप a bow.

m. (-कः)
Kalonji, (Nigella Indica.)
E.
स्थूल large, and जीरक cumin seed.

f. (-ता)
1 Coarseness, bulkiness.
2 Dulness, stupidity.
E.
तल् added to स्थूल; also with त्व, स्थूलत्वं.

m. (-ण्डः)
A sort of reed, (Arundo.)
E.
स्थूल large, दण्ड a stick or stem.

m. (-र्भः)
A kind of grass, (Saccharum munja.)
E.
स्थूल large, and दर्भ Poa.

f. (-ला)
The Aloe plant.
E.
स्थूल large, and दल a leaf.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Dull, stupid.
E.
स्थूल, and धी understanding.

m. (-लः)
A large kind of reed.
E.
स्थूल large, and नाल a stalk.

m. (-सः)
A hog.
E.
स्थूल large, and नास for नासिका nose.

m. (-कः)
A hog, a boar.
E.
स्थूल large, नासिका the nose, made masc. in the compound.

m. (-ट्टः)
Cotton.
n. (-ट्टं)
Coarse cloth.
E.
स्थूल, and पट्ट cloth.

m. (-कः)
Coarse cloth.
E.
स्थूल large, पट्ट cloth, अक to be, aff. अच्.

m. (-दः)
An elephant.
E.
स्थूल large, and पाद a foot.

m. (-ष्पः)
A tree, (Æschynomene grandiflora.)
f. (-ष्पा)
A flower, a sort of mountain Clitorea.
E.
स्थूल large, पुष्प a flower.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Stupid, dull.
E.
स्थूल, and बुद्धि understanding.

m. (-द्रः)
One of the sacred personages called Śrutā Kevalīs by the Jainas.

n. (-चं)
A fragrant medicinal berry, commonly Kakoli.
E.
स्थूल large, and मरिच black pepper.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Munificent, liberal.
2 Learned, well. read.
3 Remembering both benefits and offences.
E.
स्थूल large, much, and लक्ष mark or note.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
1 Munificent, liberal.
2 Dealing profusely or indiscriminately.
3 Recollecting benefits and injuries.
4 Taking careless aim.
E.
स्थूल a heap, (of wealth,) and लक्ष्य to be remarked or seen.

Liberality.
2

Aiming carelessly.
3 Retentiveness of benefits and injuries.
E.
स्थूललक्ष्य, and त्व aff.

m. (-कृत्)
A plant, (Siphonanthus Indica.)

m. (-लः)
Red Lodh, a tree, the bark of which is used as an astringent in tanning, &c.
E.
स्थूल thick, and वल्कल bark.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Large bodied.
n. (-रं)
The external or material body.
E.
स्थूल, and शरीर body.

mf. (-टकः-टका or -टिका)
Thick or coarse cloth.
E.
स्थूल thick, and शाटक cloth.

m. (-टिः)
Coarse cloth.
E.
स्थूल large, and शाटि cloth.

mfn. (-राः-राः-रः)
Large-headed.
n. (-रः)
A large head or summit.
E.
स्थूल bulky, and शिरस् the head.

f. (-का)
A large headed ant.
E.
स्थूल large, शीर्ष the head, कन् aff.

n. (-स्तं)
An elephant's trunk.
E.
स्थूल large, and हस्त the hand.

m. (-स्यः)
A snake.
E.
स्थल large, and आस्य face or head.

m. (-ली)
A camel.
E.
स्थूल large, इनि aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Thick, bulky.
2 Stupid.
E.
स्थूल, and भूत become, with च्चि aff.

m. (-यः)
1 Incompleteness, deficiency, defect.
2 The middle pace of an elephant, neither quick nor slow.
3 Pimples on the face.
4 A hill at the foot of a mountain, or a rocky fragment detached from its primitive site and forming a separate projection or promontory.
5 A hollow at the root of the elephant's tusks.
E.
स्थूल large, and उच्चय lofty.
